absent: Identifier lookup helper and sequence next operation semantics beyond header versus item distinction.
Initialization and write side usage of per family identifier protection and per object lock acquisition.
Binary layout, version selection and byte order handling for accounting records.
Concrete values and effects of accounting flags, time base, version macros and device encoding helpers.
Filesystem pin lifecycle, namespace reference counting, and credential scope primitives.
Async domain registration, global queue membership rules, and workqueue pool and ordering internals.
Compatibility translation between native and compat permission representations.

findings.text: Provides a node targeted work submission interface that selects a processor near the requested node and enqueues the item once, reporting whether the submission took effect. It is constrained to unbound queues and uses interrupt masking around the pending test.

Exposes per task accounting accumulation at exit and per namespace record emission, plus namespace teardown handling. Callers supply exit status and group termination indication while the implementation aggregates timing, faults, memory size and flags under signal protection.

Defines a pluggable IPC lifecycle interface with creation, association and additional validation operations parameterized by namespace and creation parameters. Implementations back the semaphore, message and shared memory families.

Creation parameter bundle carries a key, a flag word, and a variant payload that holds either a memory size for shared segments or a semaphore count. The variant is interpreted according to the IPC family requesting creation.
Operation vector for IPC families holds three callbacks for creation, association and extra checks, each operating on namespace or permission objects with creation parameters.

Compatibility permission descriptor carries key, user and group identities with creator variants in compat width, a mode field, and a sequence number for identifier reuse detection. It mirrors the native permission shape at reduced widths.

Accounting session object aggregates filesystem pin, reference count, reclamation head, serialization mutex, activity and space check flags, next check time, open file, pid namespace, deferred close work, completion signal, and a reusable record buffer.
Asynchronous job descriptor links into per domain and global pending queues, embeds deferred work, and stores a cookie, callback, opaque argument and owning domain pointer for execution and teardown.

Base identifier shift is fifteen yielding thirty two thousand entries while extended shift is twenty four yielding a much larger space. Index masking and minimum cycle values derive from these shifts and radix tree fanout.
IPC family selectors are small integers with semaphore zero, message one and shared memory two, used to index per namespace identifier arrays.

Legacy compact encoding uses thirteen bit mantissa with three bit base eight exponent while wider variant uses twenty bit mantissa with five bit base two exponent. Upper bounds govern saturation behavior on overflow.

Accounting space hysteresis defaults to resume above four percent free and suspend below two percent free, with a thirty second interval between filesystem free space rechecks exposed through a three element control table.
Async subsystem caps outstanding work at thirty two thousand entries, starts cookies at one with monotonic increment, and reserves all bits set as an infinity marker meaning no work in progress.

Proc iteration over IPC identifiers holds the per family read write semaphore for read across the whole sequence step, acquired at start and released at stop, with any per object lock released before the semaphore.

Per session mutex serializes activation, teardown and record fill plus write paths and is held across space checks and buffer preparation. Signal protection guards process accounting aggregates and terminal reference during sampling.

Global spin protection with interrupt save guards cookie allocation, pending queue insertion and removal, and live entry counting. Queue removal and memory release occur under this protection with waiter wakeup after unlock.

Node submission masks interrupts around pending acquisition and disabled state check. Internal queuing requires interrupts disabled, holds read side critical section for queue selection, and pins work to its prior executing pool when still running to preserve non reentrancy.

Sequence positions treat negative offsets as invalid with no output, zero as header only token, and positive offsets as identifier lookup keys. Header rendering delegates to family specific display for non header items.

Enabling accounting requires a regular file opened for writing on a user visible filesystem, excluding kernel internal and user namespace restricted types. The file is reopened internally as append oriented with large file support and held via cloned mount.

Space supervision caches next check deadline and skips filesystem queries until expiry. When active it pauses on low availability while when paused it resumes only after higher availability is observed, avoiding flapping.

Compact time and resource encodings shift and round large inputs into mantissa plus exponent form and saturate to the largest representable value on exponent overflow rather than wrapping. Zero maps to zero in the floating variant.

Record emission temporarily lifts file size limits and performs writes under the credentials of the accounting enabler at append position, restoring limits afterwards. Frozen filesystems are skipped via try lock to avoid deadlock.

Cookies increase strictly per submission and entries append at queue tails. Global visibility is conditional on domain registration, while per domain queuing always occurs. Lowest outstanding cookie queries return infinity when the relevant queue is empty.
Utility header is idempotent via a conventional include guard macro preventing repeated processing within a translation unit.
Deferred async jobs execute on a dedicated workqueue with node aware placement, and completion durations are measured as microseconds elapsed on a monotonic clock for diagnostics.

Accounting session toggles between active and paused based on sampled free space against distinct suspend and resume thresholds with timed reevaluation. Paused intervals skip buffer fill and write while retaining the open session.

Each job moves from allocated to pending on queues, to executing in worker context, then to unlinked and freed with waiter notification. Scheduling increments live count while completion decrements it after unlinking.

Proc file lifecycle acquires private iterator, binds family interface, and takes references on IPC and pid namespaces at open while release drops both references and frees the iterator. Iteration itself is header then items then cleanup.

Enabling allocates and initializes a new session, publishes it by exchange, and retires any prior session via pin invalidation with deferred close and completion wait. Disabling and namespace exit follow the same invalidation path without allocation.

System call entry requires process accounting privilege. With a pathname it serializes activation under a dedicated mutex while with null it tears down current pid namespace accounting. Namespace exit provides a second teardown path.

Proc file operations expose permanent entries with open, sequential read, seek and release handlers. Sequence operations wire start, stop, next and show callbacks to provide header plus per identifier listing under read protection.

Deferred close handler writes a final record, flushes when supported, releases the file synchronously and signals completion. Exit time hooks walk current to root pid namespaces emitting records where sessions exist.
Early initialization registers the three element accounting parameter vector under the kernel control hierarchy with read write permissions for privileged tuning.

Free space sampling may block on filesystem stat and must not run under non sleepable protection. Session lookup uses reference acquisition with retry on race against teardown and revalidates identity under mutex before use.

Queuing to draining or destroying queues triggers a one time warning and leaves the item unqueued after restoring pool state without lingering pending indication. Node submission warns when used on non unbound queues due to simplified processor selection.
